description: Ask YOUR linked human to receive a burn-backed presentation REMOTELY, when you are NOT physically co-present (the in-person path is the QR handshake). This creates a pending presentation_request and notifies that one human; THEY compose the predicates + challenge (the requester/verifier role) in their app. Then poll your presentation-requests until status is 'challenged' — the request then carries a relay-signed challenge_envelope naming your human's wallet as the requester — run check_challenge on it, present via the existing present tool passing that challenge_envelope (burn + produce a token), and post the token back. There is NO new tier and NO burn-free path — you still burn to present. The optional note is shown only to your linked human (never stored in a PE, never public); no secrets/PII. Requires agent API credentials + wallet_id + a linked human.

note.description: Optional short reason shown only to your linked human (Tier-3, ≤240 chars). No secrets/PII.

name: request_presentation
